svg.aria-label: How to write ൧ ൨ ൩ ൪ ൫: 5 digits, ൧, ൨, ൩, ൪, ൫, one after another
svg.title: Writing ൧ ൨ ൩ ൪ ൫
svg.desc: 5 digits written one after another: ൧, ൨, ൩, ൪, ൫ (malayalam). Each digit has its own group of frames; frame N of a group shows movements 1 to N of that digit, the movement being added drawn in ink over the finished digit, whose outline is read from _fonts/NotoSansMalayalam-Static.ttf. Each digit is drawn at its own scale from its own cited stroke order, so the strip does not show how large the digits are next to each other, how far apart they sit, or any join between them. Stroke order: ൧: Sachin Nandakumar, Jayasree: Malayalam handwriting, animated stroke by stroke (github.com/sachn1/jayasree, commit e0c9d57, October 2026), js/src/stroke-data.raw.json: the hand-recorded centre-line stroke for ൧; "Jayasree" by Sachin Nandakumar, CC BY 4.0 <https://github.com/sachn1/jayasree/blob/e0c9d57dd32031c948da4d5f8432aae3e22c5bba/js/src/stroke-data.raw.json>; ൨: Sachin Nandakumar, Jayasree: Malayalam handwriting, animated stroke by stroke (github.com/sachn1/jayasree, commit e0c9d57, October 2026), js/src/stroke-data.raw.json: the hand-recorded centre-line stroke for ൨; "Jayasree" by Sachin Nandakumar, CC BY 4.0 <https://github.com/sachn1/jayasree/blob/e0c9d57dd32031c948da4d5f8432aae3e22c5bba/js/src/stroke-data.raw.json>; ൩: Sachin Nandakumar, Jayasree: Malayalam handwriting, animated stroke by stroke (github.com/sachn1/jayasree, commit e0c9d57, October 2026), js/src/stroke-data.raw.json: the hand-recorded centre-line stroke for ൩; "Jayasree" by Sachin Nandakumar, CC BY 4.0 <https://github.com/sachn1/jayasree/blob/e0c9d57dd32031c948da4d5f8432aae3e22c5bba/js/src/stroke-data.raw.json>; ൪: Sachin Nandakumar, Jayasree: Malayalam handwriting, animated stroke by stroke (github.com/sachn1/jayasree, commit e0c9d57, October 2026), js/src/stroke-data.raw.json: the hand-recorded centre-line stroke for ൪; "Jayasree" by Sachin Nandakumar, CC BY 4.0 <https://github.com/sachn1/jayasree/blob/e0c9d57dd32031c948da4d5f8432aae3e22c5bba/js/src/stroke-data.raw.json>; ൫: Sachin Nandakumar, Jayasree: Malayalam handwriting, animated stroke by stroke (github.com/sachn1/jayasree, commit e0c9d57, October 2026), js/src/stroke-data.raw.json: the hand-recorded centre-line stroke for ൫; "Jayasree" by Sachin Nandakumar, CC BY 4.0 <https://github.com/sachn1/jayasree/blob/e0c9d57dd32031c948da4d5f8432aae3e22c5bba/js/src/stroke-data.raw.json>. Source notes on variation: ൧: Jayasree records ൧ as one stroke: up the left stem from its foot, clockwise over the arch and down the right side, back left along the baseline past the stem, then a curl below the line that ends heading right (start at the stem's foot, end at the lower tip). Jayasree keeps one recorded gesture per pen-down stroke, so one stroke means the recorder did not lift. Only these facts (stroke count, start, order, direction and end) are taken; no recorded coordinate is copied. The stroke data is licensed CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/) as "Jayasree" by Sachin Nandakumar, https://github.com/sachn1/jayasree; this record adapts it, and the pen path is fitted to the bundled Noto Sans Malayalam outline rather than to the recording, which was drawn over the Manjari typeface. One recorder, so confidence is medium. ൨: Jayasree records ൨ as one stroke: up the left side from its lower tip, clockwise over the top and down to the foot of the right side, then right along the baseline (start lower left, end lower right). Jayasree keeps one recorded gesture per pen-down stroke, so one stroke means the recorder did not lift. Only these facts (stroke count, start, order, direction and end) are taken; no recorded coordinate is copied. The stroke data is licensed CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/) as "Jayasree" by Sachin Nandakumar, https://github.com/sachn1/jayasree; this record adapts it, and the pen path is fitted to the bundled Noto Sans Malayalam outline rather than to the recording, which was drawn over the Manjari typeface. One recorder, so confidence is medium. ൩: Jayasree records ൩ as one stroke: up the left side, clockwise over the first arch and down the stem to its foot, back up the stem, clockwise over the second arch, then right along the baseline (start lower left, end lower right). The climb back up the stem retraces ink the stroke has just drawn. Jayasree keeps one recorded gesture per pen-down stroke, so one stroke means the recorder did not lift. Only these facts (stroke count, start, order, direction and end) are taken; no recorded coordinate is copied. The stroke data is licensed CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/) as "Jayasree" by Sachin Nandakumar, https://github.com/sachn1/jayasree; this record adapts it, and the pen path is fitted to the bundled Noto Sans Malayalam outline rather than to the recording, which was drawn over the Manjari typeface. One recorder, so confidence is medium. ൪: Jayasree records ൪ as one stroke: up the left side and over the top, down through the crossing and round the bottom of the bowl, back up through the crossing, and on to the top (start lower left, end upper right). Manjari ends the stroke with a straight rise where Noto curls to the upper right; the order and turning are the same, so the path follows Noto's curl. Jayasree keeps one recorded gesture per pen-down stroke, so one stroke means the recorder did not lift. Only these facts (stroke count, start, order, direction and end) are taken; no recorded coordinate is copied. The stroke data is licensed CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/) as "Jayasree" by Sachin Nandakumar, https://github.com/sachn1/jayasree; this record adapts it, and the pen path is fitted to the bundled Noto Sans Malayalam outline rather than to the recording, which was drawn over the Manjari typeface. One recorder, so confidence is medium. ൫: Jayasree records ൫ as one stroke: up the small inner curve from its lower tip, round its top into the notch in the middle, back out and round the right bowl, along the bottom and up the outer left side, then over the top and down the right (start at the inner lower tip, end at the outer lower right). The turn out of the notch retraces a short stretch of ink. Jayasree keeps one recorded gesture per pen-down stroke, so one stroke means the recorder did not lift. Only these facts (stroke count, start, order, direction and end) are taken; no recorded coordinate is copied. The stroke data is licensed CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/) as "Jayasree" by Sachin Nandakumar, https://github.com/sachn1/jayasree; this record adapts it, and the pen path is fitted to the bundled Noto Sans Malayalam outline rather than to the recording, which was drawn over the Manjari typeface. One recorder, so confidence is medium.
svg.text: How it is written — 5 digits, one after another
Digit 1 of 5 — one unbroken stroke · 4 movements
Digit 2 of 5 — one unbroken stroke · 3 movements
Digit 3 of 5 — one unbroken stroke · 5 movements
Digit 4 of 5 — one unbroken stroke · 4 movements
Digit 5 of 5 — one unbroken stroke · 5 movements
